# lean-pkg next

read-only: the single recommended next command for a package, with a one-line reason (exit 0 a command to run, 1 blocked).

## Usage

```text
lean-pkg next [--agent A] [--repo DIR] [--json] NAME
```

## Arguments and flags

| Argument or flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `NAME` |   |
| `--agent A` | who is asking: a live lease held by another agent blocks (exit 1); without it a live lease is only noted; also filled into the recommended command |
| `--repo DIR` | evaluate the checkout DIR instead of the registered local_path, for this call only (never saved; stderr note, JSON repo_override): for a host whose registered path holds another branch. DIR must be a git work tree, and when it has remotes one must be the package's repo (Host:/p matches a local-path repo /p; the registered local_path itself needs no remote) |

## Details

| Form | What it does | Key flags |
|---|---|---|
| `next NAME` | read-only and offline (no `gh` call, no network, nothing written): from the registry record and the checkout, the single recommended next command and a one-line reason. In order: terminal status (`upstreamed`, `archived`): nothing to do; no checkout: blocked, the `update NAME --path DIR --reason .. --dry-run` fix of `audit`'s missing-path; an unparseable lease: blocked, `release --force`; a live lease held by another agent (with `--agent`): blocked, never `--force`; `scratch`/`active` without a live lease: `claim`; claimed `scratch`: `update --status active`; claimed `active`: `update --status gate-pending` once a lower-tier receipt in `.lean-receipts/` binds HEAD (judged by the `gate` validator), else `gate --check --receipt R` (produce the receipt first); `gate-pending`: `gate --receipt R [--comparator C]` with the receipt found on disk (the reason points to `gate --check` first), blocked by a dirty tree or a receipt at HEAD that `gate` would refuse; `verified-private`: re-gate when the receipt no longer binds HEAD, `comparator --receipt` for a valid comparator receipt on disk, `lean-pkg receipt comparator --repo DIR` when configs are tracked, `comparator config --from-claims` (the first of `comparator coverage`'s next commands) or `claims sync` when none is, `publish --dry-run` (then `promote`) with comparator evidence and the claims ledger `ready`, else the ledger's first fix (`comparator coverage`'s first command when a reusable theorem or lemma is not compared, otherwise `claims ledger NAME`, and with no claims the reason adds how to write, migrate or sync them), with the reason `promote would refuse: claims ledger …`; blocked by a dirty tree or an unreadable recorded receipt; `public`: `update --status upstreamed` with upstream evidence, the tag command of `publish`, `reservoir check`, `record consent-recorded` / `palomar prepare` / `record palomar-submitted` (`upstream_target: palomar`), `record mathlib-pr-opened` (`mathlib`), else nothing. Without `--agent` a live lease is a note, not a blocker; a checkout on a branch other than its default (`origin/HEAD`, else `main`/`master`) or on a detached HEAD adds the note `evaluating branch X, not the default D` (`evaluating a detached HEAD <sha12>, ...`), and HEAD is still what is judged. Exit 0 with a command (or nothing left), 1 blocked, 2 usage; `--json`: `{ok, name, command, reason, blockers[{kind, detail}], notes[], state{status, visibility, lease, gate_commit, comparator_commit, head, checkout, dirty[], receipt_candidate, rejected_receipts[], comparator_configs[], claims_ledger}}` (`claims_ledger` {package_status, counts, required, ledger_digest} once both tiers bind HEAD, else null), blocker kinds `foreign-lease`, `invalid-lease`, `missing-checkout`, `no-commit`, `dirty-tree`, `invalid-receipt`, `unreadable-receipt`, `below-toolchain-floor`. A comparator step (`lean-pkg receipt comparator`, `comparator config`) is blocked first when the `lean-toolchain` committed at HEAD (else the registry's) is below the comparator floor `audit` checks (`--toolchain-floor` default, `LEAN_PKG_TOOLCHAIN_FLOOR`): `command` null, blocker `below-toolchain-floor` {detail, lean_toolchain, floor, deferred_command}, and the reason says to bump the toolchain, commit and re-gate (a legacy-mechanism comparator receipt still works below the floor but is not what Palomar runs); attaching a comparator receipt already on disk is not blocked | `[--agent A]` `[--repo DIR]` (evaluate the checkout `DIR` instead of the registered `local_path`, for this one call, as on a host whose registered path holds another branch: never written to the registry; a stderr note; JSON `repo_override` {path, registered_path, remote_match}, `null` without it; `DIR` must be a git work tree, and when it has remotes and the record names a repository one must be it, otherwise the caller vouches for it; a recommended `gate --check` carries `--repo DIR`, and any other recommended command that reads the checkout gets a note that it reads the registered path) |

## Exit codes

0 success (dry runs and no-ops included), 1 refused or failed, 2 usage error; see [Exit codes](../cli.md#exit-codes).

Exit 1 is also a negative answer here:

- `next NAME`: the package is blocked (`blockers[]` names why)

## JSON output

Top-level keys of `--json`, as recorded in the golden contract (tests/golden/json-keys.json):

- `next` (exit 0): `blockers`, `command`, `name`, `notes`, `ok`, `reason`, `repo_override`, `state`

## Examples

The single command to run now for this package, with a one-line reason; exit 1 when it is blocked.

```bash
lean-pkg next my-proof
```

Sample output:

```text
my-proof (active): lean-pkg lease claim my-proof --workspace W --agent A --reason "..."
  why: status active and no live lease: claim the package before working on it
```

The same as JSON (`command`, `reason`, `blockers`, `state`) for an agent or a script.

```bash
lean-pkg next my-proof --json
```
